mui.whyNotAMintDefect: table@1 has one cellRuleWidth token and writes it as a uniform Figma stroke on the cell. Adjacent 1px + 1px reads as 2px. That is the compile lowering, not a writer inventing a second stroke.
mui.whyNotASilentSourceLoss: The MUI extract names a bottom rule, not collapsed table borders. The recipe cannot spell per-side cell strokes; the adapter maps the 1px #e0e0e0 rule onto cellRuleWidth. Inventing strokeBottomWeight-only cells would be a new model, not a same-class teaching.
